mechanism: Disulfiram may inhibit CYP3A4 and increase dolutegravir levels; additionally, both drugs can cause neurological adverse effects including peripheral neuropathy and CNS depression.
action: Monitor for increased dolutegravir toxicity (headache, insomnia, neuropsychiatric effects) and dolutegravir efficacy; consider dolutegravir level monitoring if available; counsel patient on alcohol avoidance (required for disulfiram therapy anyway).
